prompt: CSS contain property computed value keywords
answer:
The `contain` property’s computed value is:

- `none`, or
- one or more of `size`, `layout`, `paint` (per the W3C specification)

The shorthand values compute as:

- `strict` → `size layout paint style`
- `content` → `layout paint style`

MDN lists the computed value as **“as specified.”** ([MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/Reference/Properties/contain), [W3C](https://www.w3.org/TR/css-contain-2/))
